# f5xc_protected_application (Resource)

Configures application protected by Bot Defense

To get more information about f5xc_protected_application, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/shape-bot-defense-protected-application)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Protected Application - Basic

resource "f5xc_protected_application" "example" {
  name      = "example-protected-application"
  namespace = "default"
  region    = ["US"]

  connector_type_choice = {
    big_ip_iapp = true
  }
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Protected Application - Full

resource "f5xc_protected_application" "example" {
  name        = "example-protected-application"
  namespace   = "default"
  description = "Full protected application example"
  region      = ["US"]

  labels = {
    env  = "example"
    team = "platform"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner = "example-owner"
  }

  connector_type_choice = {
    custom_connector = true
  }
}
```

- `java_script_choice` (Attributes) JavaScript Choice For Manual JavaScript Insertion, add the JS tags to one of the recommended locations: Immediately After <Head>, Immediately After </title>, Before <script> (first script tag on the page). - `loglevel` (List of String) loglevel Select the level of logging desired. Levels are cumulative (e.g. Debug includes Error, Warning, and Informational)<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['LOG_DEBUG', 'LOG_ERROR', 'LOG_INFO', 'LOG_WARNING']`<br>**Default:** `LOG_ERROR`
- `mobile_sdk_choice` (Attributes) Mobile SDK Choice Configure Mobile SDK parameters to protect native mobile app endpoints. If you have selected client type as 'Mobile' or 'Web And Mobile' please Enable Mobile SDK. In the event that there is at least one protected endpoint marked with a client type of 'Web And Mobile', then also define Mobile Request Identifier(s) in advanced setting.<br>Exactly one of `disable_mobile_sdk` or `mobile_sdk_config` must be specified when `mobile_sdk_choice` is configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_type_choice--cloudfront--mobile_sdk_choice))

- `trusted_clients` (Attributes List) Trusted Client Rules Define your allowlists to skip Bot Defense inference processing (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_type_choice--cloudfront--trusted_clients))

- `manual_js_insert` (Attributes) manual_js_insert Insert JavaScript manually<br>Conflicts with `disable_js_insert` and `js_insertion_rules`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_type_choice--cloudfront--java_script_choice--manual_js_insert))

<a id="nestedatt--connector_type_choice--cloudfront--java_script_choice--js_insertion_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connector_type_choice.cloudfront.java_script_choice.js_insertion_rules`

Required:

- `javascript_location` (List of String) javascript_location Defines where to insert Bot Defense JavaScript in HTML page.<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['AFTER_HEAD', 'AFTER_TITLE_END', 'BEFORE_SCRIPT']`
- `javascript_mode` (List of String) javascript_mode Determine the mode in which the JavaScript is loaded into the entry page. The JavaScript is split into 2 chunks. The larger chunk can be loaded asynchronously or synchronously. It can also be cacheable or non-cacheable on the browser.<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['ASYNC_JS_CACHING', 'ASYNC_JS_NO_CACHING', 'SYNC_JS_CACHING', 'SYNC_JS_NO_CACHING']`
- `rules` (Attributes List) rules Required list of pages to insert Bot Defense client JavaScript. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_type_choice--cloudfront--java_script_choice--js_insertion_rules--rules))

Optional:

- `exclude_list` (Attributes List) exclude_list Optional JavaScript insertions exclude list of domain and path matchers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_type_choice--cloudfront--java_script_choice--js_insertion_rules--exclude_list))
- `js_download_path` (String) js_download_path Web client will fetch F5 Client Java Script from this path. This path must not conflict with any other website/application paths. If not specified, default to ‘/common.js’.<br>**Default:** `/common.js`

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_protected_application.example <namespace>/<name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<name>"
	to = f5xc_protected_application.example
}
```
